LESSON: POLITE LANGUAGE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Polite language
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Polite language, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which words do we use to request for something? 2. Which words do we use to show that we are sorry?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
